ig_caption:
Rules are laws. Skills are know-how. Tools are hands ✋

📏 Rules: always on, in every request. Keep them short.
📚 Skills: loaded only when the task needs them. A skill is just a folder of instructions (sometimes with scripts).
🛠 Tools: actions. Query the DB, create a ticket, call an API. The model decides when.

Put each thing in the right place and the same model suddenly looks much smarter.

Part 5/6 of Agent Harness 101. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
